scope: Offline source and recorded-evidence inventory; no network execution, security certification or score prediction.
verificationPolicy: Code presence, declared metadata and hash-matched recorded artifacts are distinct evidence levels. The offline gate cannot certify production readiness or independent execution.

observations.description: Listings and purchase coordination are server-hosted. Co-signed settlement is non-custodial; this does not make the order service decentralized.

checks.reason: Wallet Standard and injected adapters are wired to the UI. Automated adapter tests are available; a real browser-extension session is separate evidence.
RPC balance and verified Fee Key discovery source are present; no fictional fallback is imported by the UI.
Raydium CPMM Burn & Earn decoder and ownership/lock/mint checks are present. The separate mainnet-read artifact supplies a recorded live observation.
Atomic SPL NFT transfer plus exact SOL payment, both signatures and canonical-message checks are implemented. Runtime evidence is assessed separately.
